# 00000002692

**English.** Definition: p-adic contraction of dynamical systems: iterative convergence on p-adic balls. Conjecture: The measure of the attracting basin of a p-adic contraction is an explicit fraction of the ball volume; the denominator of the fraction is the order of the multiplier mod p, and the boundary of the basin is the closure of periodic points. (p-adic attracting basin measure)

**中文。** 定义：动力系统的 p-adic 收缩：p-adic 球上的迭代收敛。猜想：p-adic 收缩映射的吸引域的测度为球体积的显式分数；分数的分母为乘子模 p 的阶且吸引域的边界为周期点的闭包。（p-adic 吸引域测度）

issues.title: Disproof of conjecture 00000002692 (5x+x^2 on Z_5: no multiplier order, basin 1/5, boundary non-periodic)
issues.body:
## Disproof of conjecture 00000002692 (p-adic attracting basin measure)

**Verdict: FALSE — all three clauses fail at f(x) = 5x + x² on Z_5.**

1. **No denominator exists.** The multiplier f′(0) = 5 ≡ 0 (mod 5), and 0 has no multiplicative order mod 5 (0^k = 0 ≠ 1 for all k ≥ 1) — the conjecture's "denominator = order of the multiplier mod p" cannot be formed.
2. **The fraction's denominator is p, not an order.** The basin of 0 is exactly 5Z_5 (x ∈ 5Z_5 ⟹ |f(x)| ≤ |x|/5 → 0; x ∉ 5Z_5 ⟹ |f(x)| = |x| = 1 forever): measure exactly **1/5** of the ball — denominator 5 = p. Verified as an exact 1/5-fraction on the grid models Z/25, Z/125, Z/625 (5/25, 25/125, 125/625 — precisely the multiples of 5).
3. **The boundary is not the closure of periodic points.** The basin-boundary shell 5Z_5∖25Z_5 maps straight to 0: f(x) = x(5+x) ≡ 0 (mod 25) for every x ≡ 0 (mod 5) — one step into the basin, never to return. Mod 25 the periodic points are {0, 21 = −4 (fixed), 1, 6, 11, 16 (4-cycle)} — all off the shell {5,10,15,20}, none of which is periodic.

### Kernel (Lean 4 core, v4.33.1) — all zero-axiom

7 theorems: `multiplier_zero_mod_p`, `zero_has_no_order` (∀ k ≥ 1, 0^k ≠ 1, by cases on k), `basin_fraction` (5·5 = 25), `denominator_mismatch` (5 ≠ 1), `shell_maps_to_zero`, `shell_not_periodic`, `conjecture_refuted`. `#print axioms` audit: **does not depend on any axioms** for all seven.

### reproduce.py

No order of 0 mod 5 (k = 1..99); basin = multiples of 5 exactly at depths 2..4; periodic points mod 25 enumerated vs the shell.

comments.body: Not merged after review. The main Lean theorem is vacuous arithmetic trivia with NONE of the conjecture's objects in Lean — the actual mathematical content lives only in prose/tex/Python. Specifically:  the main theorem is a conjunction of trivia (5 % 5 = 0, 0^k ≠ 1, 5*5 = 25, 5 ≠ 1) plus 8 spot evaluations of (5x+x²) mod 25; no p-adic basin, measure, boundary, or periodic-point structure appears in Lean.
